paper.table_caption: Table 1: Exact match metric on QA1-5 Babilong subsets. Each column corresponds to some constant context length. Context includes both noise sentences and facts. * The 50M exact-match on QA1 is measured on 1 best model. ARMT rows are 3 runs averaged. Mamba rows are 2 runs averaged. The metric is marked bold if its ±std interval intersects the ±std interval of the best model.

armt.note: published numbers, not rerun; means of 3 runs; the s.d. is recorded but not drawn

leaderboard.defect: the leaderboard's ARMT qa5 row equals its avg row from 4k onward (4k 98.1 ... 1M 93.4, 10M 76.6), so its qa5 cells at 1M and 10M are the QA1-5 mean, not QA5; the paper's Table 1 gives QA5 = 97.3 (1M) and 80.9 (10M), and with those the mean of the five tasks reproduces the leaderboard's avg (93.4, 76.6)
